title: ChatReply
description: Reply to a chat turn. When pending_proposal is present, the UI shows a confirmation card with exactly its terms; confirming calls POST /v1/actions/proposals/{proposal_id}/confirm.

fallback_used.description: True when the text is the deterministic narration (offline mode, or the model's explanation failed verification).

pending_expense.description: An expense the copilot prepared from what the user said (ADR-039). The UI shows it for the user to check, complete (cash or card, category) and confirm; confirming calls POST /v1/expenses/{proposal_id}/confirm. Nothing is stored before.

pending_memory_proposal.description: A net salary the copilot read from this message (ADR-048). The UI shows the memory card for the user to select or type the amount, check the pay month and confirm with POST /v1/memory/proposals/{proposal_id}/confirm. Nothing is saved before; confirming moves no money and does not change the projections.

memory_dependency.description: Present when the reply relied on the user's memory: the counters it read (memory_consent), current when the reply was published. The counters only grow: once a client has seen either one larger (from GET or PUT /v1/memory/consent or another reply), the whole reply is obsolete and the client hides it: text, facts, cards and actions. A reply whose memory moved during its turn is never published: it comes back as MEMORY_CHANGED, without this field.
